parameters.content:
## Create a rebooking video for no-shows

### How it works
Read a recorded no-show from Google Sheets or a webhook and render a personalized invitation to rebook. Optionally email the video and record the result. The workflow does not detect attendance itself.

### Setup
1. Install **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Create a **Zvid API** credential with [your API key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys) and Base URL `https://api.zvid.io`. Select it on every Zvid node.
3. Connect both Google Sheets nodes to the same spreadsheet and tab, or set source=webhook and POST inviteeFirstName and eventName.
4. Set presenterName, brandName, rebookUrl, highlights and timeZone in Config. Optional delivery needs SMTP and sendEmail=true.
5. **dryRun=false** renders and spends Zvid credits. Set it to **true** for an editor draft and quote.
6. Test manually and review the output before activating automatic runs.

### Customization
Adjust branding, media and timing in the configuration node. [Detailed setup guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/no-show-reengagement.md).

parameters.content:
## 1. Choose settings and an entry point

Complete the overview setup first. Use the manual trigger for a test, then check the trigger settings and workflow timezone before activation.

## 2. Load recorded no-shows

Sheet headers: FirstName, Email, EventName, OriginalTime, RebookUrl, Status, VideoUrl. FirstName and EventName are required. Leave Status empty; trigger webhook mode from your actual attendance record.

## 3. Check for a pending reminder

Proceed only when a no-show is available. An empty queue ends without rendering or sending.

## 4. Check the background music

Check the configured track or stock candidates before use. Follow the guard’s result when music is unavailable.

## 5. Build and validate the design

Prepare the media and video design, then validate the payload and credit quote. Resolve validation errors before submitting a render.

## 6. Choose an optional editor preview

dryRun=true returns an editor draft and credit quote. The default false branch renders and spends Zvid credits; upstream AI services may charge separately.

## 7. Render and wait for completion

Submit the render, then check its status until completion or timeout. Keep each result paired with its source item. Check Zvid before retrying a timed-out job.

## 8. Optionally send the rebooking video

Configure SMTP and enable sendEmail to deliver the link. Confirm the booking URL and recipient in a private test.

## 9. Record or return the result

Update the matching sheet row or respond to the webhook caller. Allow the caller time for video rendering.

## 10. Review the finished media

Open Watch video → Binary → data → View. Select each output item for batches; image outputs open as images. Empty links and preview results skip the download.
